annotations.title: Check a supplier invoice before paying (paid)

description: Use before an agent pays a supplier invoice: checks the supplier in official registers, screens it, its directors, owners and parent companies against EU, UN, UK and US sanctions and PEP, matches the VAT number, checks the IBAN (valid, same country as the company, registered on the Polish VAT whitelist), the sender's email domain and Dutch bankruptcy, and whether the supplier is on Peppol. One verdict: pass, review or hold. Costs 0.08 USDC via x402, or 40 credits of a Factline API key.

country.description: Supplier's ISO country, e.g. BE, NL, GB, PL

email.description: Email address the invoice came from

iban.description: IBAN the invoice asks you to pay

kvk.description: Dutch KvK number: adds a bankruptcy check

name.description: Supplier company name, e.g. Colruyt Group

name: supplier_invoice_check
